ops-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE created by paging-rule:latency-slo-p99 — p99 spike detected for streaming endpoints (rule id 9f3a). Alert window: 5m. Severity: P2.
Sasha R: I'm on it, paging in. seeing alerts in Grafana for streaming-client tail latency. grabbing traces.
Mike L: noticed a sudden jump in p95/p99 around 2023-11-18T14:03Z. p95 220ms -> 480ms, p99 1.8s -> 4.6s.
Jen T: KV cache metrics show a big increase in fragment count and free segments dropping on kv-shard-7. prefill hit ratio dropped from 0.86 -> 0.42. decode path CPU stayed stable. looks like prefill vs decode imbalance.
Sasha R: streaming stalls metric (streaming_conn_stalled) went from 12 -> 110 in the same window. many streams stuck waiting on kv fetch.
Mike L: running quick query: `./tools/kv-stats --shard 7 --fields hit_rate,fragments,load` -> `hit_rate=0.42 fragments=3149 load=0.87`
Jen T: logs show rapid eviction churn from the prefill queue: `evict(reason=prefill_pressure) shard=7 items=174`. decode workers hitting cache misses and causing tail spikes.
Sasha R: Customer impact?
Mike L: preliminary: ~12k streaming requests in last 15m, ~0.9k had middleware stalls >2s. Error rate on streaming fallback increased from 0.8% -> 2.5% across affected shards. Two customers reported degraded UX for chat streaming.
Sasha R: Okay, mitigation plan (live): 1) Immediately throttle prefill workers on shard-7 to reduce eviction pressure. 2) Soft-evict 25% of low-priority keys to free up contiguous segments. 3) Route new streaming sessions away from shard-7 to other healthy shards until stable. 4) If that doesn't restore p99 within 10m, temporarily switch streaming fallback model to smaller-embedding variant to reduce KV payload size.
Jen T: I'm pushing a scoped throttling patch now: `scripts/throttle-prefill.sh --shard 7 --rate 30` (reduces prefill concurrency). rolling it to one node first.
Mike L: while Jen patches, I'll run a targeted soft-evict: `./tools/kv-evict --shard 7 --policy soft --pct 25 --selector 'age>24h || size<2kb'` -> executing on node kv-7a.
Sasha R: Routing: I updated routing-policy to steer new streaming requests away from kv-7 via `routing set prefer:shards healthy -exclude kv-7` (applied to streaming-prod).
PagerDuty: Note: escalation timer set to 20m. Next oncall: Kevin P in 30m.
Kevin P: I'll take handoff in 30. if you need me sooner ping with @Kevin P.
Jen T: throttle patch rolled to kv-7a. CPU stable. prefill rate down ~65%.
Mike L: soft-evict completed on kv-7a. fragments dropped 18%. hit_rate up to 0.58 on that node.
Sasha R: After these two actions p95 down to ~260ms, p99 down to ~2.1s. Streaming stalls count falling (now ~34). Still above baseline but trending.
Jen T: I'm cascading throttle to the rest of the kv-7 replicas gradually. adding a small backoff to prefill producers to avoid thrash.
Mike L: quick note: we saw one replica (kv-7c) with persistent decode latency; restarting decode worker there cleared a stuck GC cycle. `systemctl restart decode-worker` applied.
Sasha R: Customer comms: ops, we should open a short incident note. Impact: streaming latency SLO breached for ~17m, ~12k requests, 2s+ tail for ~900 reqs, three small customers saw degradations (IDs internal/1234, internal/2345, internal/9987).
Kevin P: Will own the post-incident writeup. I'll capture runbook items and mitigation timeline in the incident doc. link when up.
Mike L: I put a temporary alert suppression for noisy prefill alerts while this is stabilizing: Grafana alertmuted:alerts/latency-prefill-7 (5m).
Jen T: Followups to prevent recurrence: - investigate allocation fragmentation strategy for kv shards - consider increasing contiguous block compaction during low traffic windows - add a dynamic cap for prefill concurrency based on free segment ratio.
Sasha R: Agreed. Also need a small diagnostic tool to correlate prefill churn and decode misses per shard (Jen, can you add a quick task?).
Jen T: Yep. I'll add task and schedule with infra.
Sasha R: Current status: mitigations applied, trends improving. Handoff to Kevin in 30m. If p99 creeps back up to >3s escalate to P1.
ops-bot: Incident created: incident/2023-11-18-kv-prefill-frag-3298765432 (link internal). Please update incident channel with final postmortem.
Kevin P: Taking handoff. noted mitigations and followups. ping me for any regression.
Sasha R: thanks everyone — monitoring for next 60m. :thumbsup:
